descriptionChirho: The proper noun Arnon (אַרְנוֹן), the name of a river (Wadi Mujib) forming the boundary between Moab and the Amorite territory, frequently mentioned in border descriptions and conquest narratives. Multilingual evidence uniformly identifies a single geographic referent: eng 'Arnon', spa 'Arnón', hin 'अर्नोन', arb 'أَرْنُونَ', kor '아르논', swa 'Arnoni'. The two clusters differ only in prepositional context (bare name, 'from Arnon' vs. 'in Arnon'), with no semantic distinction.
